svg.text: Diagram 2 of 2 · every agent, the tools it can call, and the data source each tool reads from or writes to. Flow and handoffs are in the System Flow diagram.
TOOLS → DATA SOURCE EACH ONE TOUCHES
LAYER 1 — PERCEPTION SWARM · parallel, independent, disjoint source systems
so no model is consulted at all.
redactor.scrub → search_text in the event payload
a structural read — needs no model
told whether the bank or the
a record with no consent flag is never read, whatever it contains
LAYER 2 & 3 — CORRELATION AND DECISION · reached only on the daily cycle, never on the event path
called only when the top two
gate 1 first: nothing but no_action below high confidence
NONE — set membership and len(), nothing else
no model is consulted, so nothing can be talked out of its answer
proportionality is the only question a model is asked
a CLI prompt to a human — approve / reject / modify
a rejection turns the action into no_action in the output, rather than
recording a rejection while still emitting the action
NONE — comparison and set arithmetic, no model
written to review_queue.json, alongside the graded file, never into it
raises on a change in the picture, not on its persistence
Every model call above has a deterministic fallback that the test suite exercises: C360_OFFLINE=1 runs the whole system, end to end, with no API access.
Every prompt named here lives in one file, src/c360/prompts.py. Every tool's as_of argument is mandatory and has no default, so a caller cannot omit the time filter.
Findings are structured records (agent · signal · strength · event_ids · source_systems), never prose — the guardrail counts source_systems and the output cites event_ids.
